headlines.title: 南京住房公积金管理中心：进一步扩大住房公积金异地贷款范围
headlines.summary: 南京住房公积金管理中心8月29日公告称，为更好发挥住房公积金制度作用，进一步满足购房人跨区域住房消费需求，现将住房公积金异地贷款范围扩展至全国。全国范围内的住房公积金缴存人，在南京市购房均可向南京住房公积金管理中心申请住房公积金贷款。本通知自2026年9月1日起施行。

headlines.title_en: Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center: Further Expanding Scope of Cross-Regional Housing Provident Fund Loans
headlines.summary_en: Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center announced on August 29 that, to better leverage the role of the housing provident fund system and further meet homebuyers' cross-regional housing consumption needs, the scope of housing provident fund cross-regional loans will be expanded to nationwide. Contributors to the housing provident fund across the country can apply to the Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center for housing provident fund loans when purchasing homes in Nanjing. This notice takes effect from September 1, 2026.

headlines.title: 房贷延至最多40年后个人能否贷这么长？有银行称或放宽年龄限制
headlines.summary: 8月28日，住房城乡建设部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局出台一系列政策，涉及个人住房贷款、商品房开发贷款等多个领域。 新规还明确，个人房贷最长期限从30年延长到40年，为我们买房贷款提供了更多选择。 说到这里，记者要提醒一点，银行贷款是有年龄限制的。以建设银行为例，银行要求借款人年龄+贷款期限一般要小于等于75岁，最多可以放宽到80岁。所以，房贷延长到最多40年后，能不能贷这么长，您还得问问银行。记者也第一时间打听了一下，有银行表示，今后有可能会放宽个人房贷的年龄限制。（央视）

headlines.title_en: After mortgage extension to max 40 years, can individuals borrow that long? Some banks may relax age limits
headlines.summary_en: On August 28, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the People's Bank of China, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration introduced a series of policies covering personal housing loans, commercial housing development loans, and other areas. The new rules also clarify that the maximum term for personal mortgage loans is extended from 30 to 40 years, offering more choices for homebuyers. However, reporters remind that banks impose age limits on loans. For example, China Construction Bank requires that the borrower's age plus the loan term generally not exceed 75 years, with a maximum extension to 80. So, with mortgages extended to up to 40 years, whether such long terms are available depends on the bank. Reporters quickly checked and found some banks indicating they may relax mortgage age limits in the future. (CCTV)

headlines.title: 王毅同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅29日同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话。王毅表示，中方对尼一揽子援助正在落实，包括紧急现汇援助和人道主义援助。中方提供的救灾物资即将运抵加德满都。中方隧道救援专家兵分两路，奔赴灾区和加德满都驰援。中方已同尼方分享灾区影像、卫星和水文数据等重要信息，包括上游堰塞湖预警信息。对在中方一侧滞留的尼泊尔公民，中方已作出妥善安排，将协助他们尽快返尼，感谢并希望尼方继续救助转移在尼的中国公民。中尼是山水相连、命运与共的共同体。面对灾情，两国要坚定站在一起，携手应对，共克时艰，以实际行动诠释跨越喜马拉雅的传统友谊。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi holds phone call with Nepalese Foreign Minister Dr. Arzu Rana Deuba
headlines.summary_en: Wang Yi, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, spoke by phone with Nepalese Foreign Minister Rishi on the 29th. Wang Yi stated that China's package of assistance to Nepal is being implemented, including emergency cash assistance and humanitarian aid. China's disaster relief supplies will soon arrive in Kathmandu. Chinese tunnel rescue experts have split into two groups, heading to the disaster zone and Kathmandu to provide support. China has already shared important information with Nepal, including disaster area imagery, satellite and hydrological data, and upstream glacial lake outburst warnings. For Nepalese citizens stranded on the Chinese side, China has made proper arrangements to assist their swift return to Nepal, and expressed gratitude while hoping Nepal will continue rescuing and relocating Chinese citizens in Nepal. China and Nepal are a community sharing mountains, rivers and a common destiny. In the face of the disaster, the two countries must stand firmly together, respond jointly, overcome difficulties collectively, and interpret the traditional friendship across the Himalayas with concrete actions. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 英国考虑对银行和石油公司征收暴利税
headlines.summary: 据每日电讯报，英国财政大臣希利正在考虑在其首份预算案中对银行和石油公司征收暴利税。财政部官员正在讨论这两项政策，他们试图找到办法填补公共财政47亿英镑的缺口，同时避免直接增加个人税收。据悉，希利希望下个月的预算案保持低调，并确保不可避免的增税幅度远低于前任财相里夫斯推行的增税幅度。

headlines.title_en: UK Considers Windfall Tax on Banks and Oil Companies
headlines.summary_en: According to The Daily Telegraph, UK Chancellor Healey is considering imposing windfall taxes on banks and oil companies in her first budget. Treasury officials are discussing both policies as they seek ways to fill a £4.7 billion gap in public finances while avoiding direct increases in personal taxation. It is understood that Healey wants the next month's budget to be low-key and ensure any unavoidable tax increases are far smaller than those introduced by former Chancellor Reeves.

headlines.title_en: ChangXin Memory Technologies sues US Department of Defense
headlines.summary_en: According to comprehensive foreign media reports, on August 28 local time, Chinese chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Defense demanding removal from a blacklist. Per Bloomberg, CXMT said its chips are designed for civilian and commercial use, not military, and claimed it was wrongly blacklisted. The suit was filed with the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also named as a defendant. In a statement after filing, CXMT said it is not a military enterprise and that its reputation and business interests have been continuously damaged since its initial blacklisting in January 2025, adding that the action was taken to protect commercial interests. Per Reuters, the Defense Department said in a statement that 'as a matter of policy, the department does not comment on pending or ongoing litigation.'

headlines.title: 阿联酋将在美国指其涉伊朗关联后对银行Banque Misr展开调查
headlines.summary: 阿联酋央行表示，在美国财政部采取行动、切断这家埃及银行阿联酋分行与美国金融体系的联系（作为对伊朗制裁的一部分）后，该行将对埃及银行（Banque Misr）展开调查。阿联酋央行在一份声明中表示，已“决定对该行在美国周五公告中所涉两年多期间的交易进行特别紧急检查”。其调查“包括对美国当局声明中所涉期间的回溯性法证/深度审查，重点关注声明中提及的公司的银行交易”。

headlines.title_en: UAE to Investigate Banque Misr After US Cites Iran Ties
headlines.summary_en: The UAE Central Bank stated that it will investigate Banque Misr after the US Treasury took action to cut off the Egyptian bank's UAE branch from the US financial system as part of sanctions on Iran. In a statement, the UAE Central Bank said it has "decided to conduct a special urgent review of the bank's transactions during the period of over two years covered by the US announcement on Friday." Its investigation "includes a retrospective forensic/depth review of the period covered by the US authorities' statement, focusing on banking transactions of companies mentioned in the statement."

headlines.title: 美国制裁埃及银行阿联酋分行，阿联酋央行将展开紧急检查
headlines.summary: 在美国针对埃及银行（Banque Misr）在阿联酋的分行实施涉伊制裁后，阿联酋央行表示，期望在阿联酋获准经营的银行“不使阿联酋金融体系面临声誉风险”或“滥用阿联酋先进的金融基础设施”。阿联酋央行在声明中表示，将对埃及银行在阿联酋的当地分行展开紧急检查，并强调这些分行受阿联酋法律法规约束。阿联酋央行补充称，正在“研究针对该行可能采取的特别措施的相关应对方案”。美国财政部表示，对埃及银行阿联酋分行实施的制裁是美国加强针对伊朗及其国际金融合作伙伴经济行动的一部分，此举将切断该银行分行的美元交易渠道。

headlines.title_en: US Sanctions Egyptian Bank's UAE Branch; UAE Central Bank to Launch Urgent Inspection
headlines.summary_en: After the US imposed Iran-related sanctions on Banque Misr's branch in the UAE, the UAE Central Bank said it expects banks licensed to operate in the UAE not to "expose the UAE financial system to reputational risk" or "abuse the UAE's advanced financial infrastructure." In a statement, the UAE Central Bank said it will launch an urgent inspection of Banque Misr's local branches in the UAE, emphasizing that these branches are subject to UAE laws and regulations. The UAE Central Bank added that it is "studying response options for possible special measures against the bank." The US Treasury said the sanctions on Banque Misr's UAE branch are part of intensified US economic actions against Iran and its international financial partners, and would cut off the branch's dollar transaction channels.

headlines.title: 西藏吉隆发布会：目前已动员各类救援力量2141人投入一线搜救
headlines.summary: 今天（30日），西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇举行。会上介绍，灾害发生后，西藏迅速启动自治区自然灾害一级应急响应、自治区自然灾害一级救助应急响应，成立吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部和前方指挥部。财政部、应急管理部紧急拨付1.2亿元资金，国家发改委安排1亿元资金，支持抢险救灾和灾后应急恢复工作。目前，已动员组织解放军、武警、中国消防救援队、边防、公安以及中国安能等各方救援力量2141人，调派救援车辆269辆，救援装备3922套投入一线开展搜救工作。现在，水陆空三路并进挺进受灾核心区。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Tibet Gyirong Briefing: 2,141 Rescue Personnel Deployed to Frontline Search Efforts
headlines.summary_en: Today (the 30th), a press conference on the "8·26" mudslide disaster in Gyirong, Tibet was held in Gyirong Town. At the meeting, it was stated that after the disaster occurred, Tibet quickly activated the regional natural disaster Level I emergency response and the regional natural disaster Level I relief emergency response, establishing the Gyirong County "8·26" mudslide disaster emergency rescue command and a front-line command. The Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 120 million yuan, and the National Development and Reform Commission arranged 100 million yuan to support rescue, disaster relief and post-disaster emergency recovery. Currently, 2,141 rescue personnel have been mobilized, including the People's Liberation Army, Armed Police, China Fire and Rescue, border defense, public security, and China Anneng, with 269 rescue vehicles and 3,922 sets of rescue equipment dispatched to the front line for search and rescue operations. Rescue efforts are now advancing toward the core disaster area via water, land and air routes. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: CCTV Finance: 'Chip' Wave Is Here! Chip Packaging Equipment Orders Booked Through 2028; Manufacturer Net Profit Soars Over 20-Fold
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV Finance, factory capacity has nearly tripled in half a year, company profits have surged over 20-fold, and a single order value has exceeded 10 million yuan — China's chip exports are heating up at an unprecedented pace. China's integrated circuits are experiencing a "glamour moment" in the global market. Amid the explosive global demand for computing infrastructure, memory chips have jumped to become the largest export category, with related manufacturers showing remarkable cash-generating momentum. Li Yunzhen, Assistant to the General Manager of Shannon Semiconductor, said that driven by the industry chain, the company's net profit attributable to shareholders surged over 20-fold in the first half of the year. The high prosperity is transmitting along the industry chain. "Customer orders are generally scheduled into 2028, and some customers are even coming with cash to grab products."
